title: Finding
description: A manuscript-level review judgment. references/00-contracts.md §6.1. Only M2–M7 may produce these — M1 is the upstream extraction layer and must not produce findings. Any output not conforming to this schema is invalid and discarded.

id.description: Module prefix + three-digit sequence number, e.g. M4-003. The M1- prefix is invalid.

module.description: M1 is invalid — extraction-layer observations go through extraction_signal or coverage_breakdown

category.description: A slug registered in the module's reference file; inventing new ones is forbidden

severity.description: critical=conclusion does not hold / ethics violation / suspected misconduct; major=authors must supply materials or redo analyses; minor=wording and reporting-standard issues; info=advisory note

evidence_refs.description: Must be non-empty, and each item must resolve to exactly one entry in the evidence_registry. The canonical storage form; inlining an evidence[] object array is forbidden.

rule_ref.description: Anchor of the rule that triggered this finding, e.g. 04-statistics#sample-size-reporting

review_confidence.description: How reliable this judgment itself is. Capped at medium when the evidence contains pixel_estimated values or points to ambiguous fields.

derived_from_signals.description: For provenance. Must not replace evidence_refs — establishing a finding on a signal id alone is a contract violation.

related_findings.description: Ids of other findings merged under this one during de-duplication clustering

action.description: An actionable review step: where to look, what to verify, and what to supply if confirmed

who.description: English enum; the rendering layer handles localized display

allOf.description: 00-contracts.md §6.1 rule 2: severity >= major must have a non-empty actionable step
critical blocks the review conclusion; manual review is always P0
minor/info may enter the report-level manual review plan only as P2
